title: DNS providers
purpose: Connect the DNS host of your domains so Levelrail can add records, check status and renew certificates.
empty: No DNS provider is connected yet. Pick one to connect your zones.

attention.noCredential: Enabled but no credential is stored.

sheet.title: {{provider}}
sheet.keepHint: A credential is stored. Leave the fields blank to keep it.
sheet.disconnectBody: Levelrail stops managing records and certificates in this account. Records already in DNS stay as they are.

perm.cloudflare: Needs an API token with Zone:Read and DNS:Edit on the zones you want managed.
perm.route53: Needs an IAM key pair limited to ListHostedZones, ListResourceRecordSets, ChangeResourceRecordSets and GetChange.
perm.googleclouddns: Needs a service account key with the DNS Administrator role on the project.

zones.heading: Hosted zones
zones.name: Zone name
zones.none: No hosted zones yet. Connect a provider to list its zones.

delegation.bannerDelegated: Delegated: public resolvers return this zone's name servers.
delegation.bannerPartial: Partly delegated: some resolvers still return other name servers.
delegation.bannerElsewhere: Not delegated: your domain currently uses {{servers}}. Set the name servers below at your registrar.
delegation.bannerNot: Not delegated: no name servers answer for this domain yet. Set the name servers below at your registrar.
delegation.bannerUnknown: Could not check delegation right now.
delegation.step1: Copy the name servers assigned to this zone.
delegation.step2: Open your registrar and replace the domain's name servers with them.
delegation.step3: Wait for propagation, then check again.

zone.assigned: Name servers assigned by the provider
zone.current: Name servers found in public DNS
zone.noServers: This provider did not report name servers.
zone.usedNone: No domain in Levelrail uses this zone.
